integer_encoding: canonical nonnegative decimal strings less than n
session: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; valid for 1800 seconds
challenge: GET /part08/challenge; fresh runtime public_key={n,e}, mu, session, primitive, expires_in
sign: POST /part08/sign; exact JSON fields session; returns faulty_signature and fresh unpredictable mu2
verify: POST /part08/verify; exact JSON fields session,signature; verifies the signature of mu2
secure_sign: POST /part08/secure-sign; exact JSON fields session,fault; fault must be a JSON boolean; signs original mu only
result: GET /part08/result?session=SESSION; complete,checks; flag only when complete
primitive: raw RSA integer representatives; distinct from Part07 RSA-PSS
note: Public challenge values are issued at runtime; this file contains no target private key or grading flag.
